map.→ 打开档案盒标签生成工具: -> Open the archive box label generator
map.保管期限有哪些档？: What retention period bands are there?
map.批量移交与清点：档案移交时按盒清点、盒号连续（如 012-020），用本工具逐盒: Bulk handover and inventory: when files are handed over, count them box by box with continuous box numbers (such as 012-020), and use this tool to generate a label for each box so the archive numbers stay continuous and the elements complete, easing handover and later retrieval.
map.按《文书档案保管期限表》分「永久」「定期30年」「定期10年」三档。定期档案到期: The Regulation on Retention Periods for Documentary Archives divides records into three bands: permanent, fixed term 30 years and fixed term 10 years. Fixed term records must be appraised before expiry and then destroyed or extended. Both the box face and the catalogue entry should state this truthfully so disposal at expiry is easy.
map.按《档号编制规则》生成档案盒脊背标签，支持档号、题名、年度等字段竖排排版，可直接: Generates archive box spine labels following the archive numbering rules, with vertical layout for fields such as the archive number, title and year. It can be printed on A4 paper and cut up, making tidy shelving and retrieval easier.
map.文书档案归档：某机关年度文书档案整理，全宗号 X043、目录号 001、盒号 0: Documentary archiving: an agency sorts its annual records with fonds number X043, catalogue number 001, box number 012, year 2023, retention period "permanent", department "Office", title "Annual work summary and meeting minutes", item range 001-085 and recording unit "XX City Archives", generating the standard archive number and box label in one click.
map.档号 = 全宗号-目录号-盒号，三者用短横连接。全宗号是立档单位的唯一代号，目录: Archive number = fonds number - catalogue number - box number, joined by hyphens. The fonds number is the unique code of the recording unit, the catalogue number distinguishes the category (documentary, accounting, project and so on), and the box number is the sequential number of boxes within a category. Together they identify one box uniquely within the fonds.
map.档号各部分怎么排列？: How are the parts of the archive number arranged?
map.示例：生成一张标准档案盒标签: Example: generating a standard archive box label
map.项目档案盒脊打印：工程项目中按项目立卷，需把档号、题名、年度、保管期限、起止件号: Project archive box spine printing: in engineering projects, records are filed by project, and the archive number, title, year, retention period, and start/end item numbers must be printed on the spine so that boxes can be shelved and retrieved easily; this tool assembles scattered fields into a standard label text to avoid manual transcription errors.
map.：输入 全宗号=X043、目录号=001、盒号=012、年度=2023、保管期限:
: Input: fonds number = X043, catalogue number = 001, box number = 012, year = 2023, retention period = permanent, department/issue = office, title = Annual Work Summary and Meeting Minutes, start-end item numbers = 001-085, filing unit = XX City Archives.
Archive number = fonds number-catalogue number-box number = X043-001-012; the box face shows "Archive number X043-001-012 | Title Annual Work Summary and Meeting Minutes | 2023 · Permanent | Office · Item numbers 001-085". The copied text contains the seven elements archive number, title, year, retention period, department/issue, start-end item numbers, and filing unit, and can be pasted directly into a label printing template.
